title: Cost-Aware Stopping for Freeze-Thaw Bayesian Optimization: When Does One-Step Lookahead Suffice?
abstract: arXiv:2610.42085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization (BO) evaluates candidates in resumable increments but usually stops at a budget or convergence test. We maximize a budget-free utility, the best observed score minus a cost per increment, with a one-step lookahead: advance the candidate with the largest expected improvement (EI) under a fixed surrogate, and stop once no EI exceeds the cost. This rule, EI stopping, never falls below stopping immediately in expected utility, yet it can stop too early. We construct a certificate, a lower bound on the value of two-step lookahead, that proves such a stop premature, and repeating this correction never lowers expected utility under the surrogate. Under the surrogate, EI stops are premature on average at low costs and lose little at high costs. translated_title: 面向冻结-解冻贝叶斯优化的成本感知停止：单步前瞻何时足够？
translated_abstract: 冻结-解冻贝叶斯优化（BO）以可恢复的增量方式评估候选对象，但通常在预算耗尽或收敛性检验时才停止。我们最大化一种不依赖预算的效用函数——即最佳观测得分减去每次增量的成本——并采用单步前瞻：在固定代理模型下推进期望改进（EI）最大的候选对象，一旦没有任何EI超过成本便停止。这一规则称为EI停止，其期望效用从不低于立即停止，但它可能过早停止。我们构建了一个证书——即两步前瞻价值的下界——用以证明此类停止是过早的，且在代理模型下重复这一修正过程从不会降低期望效用。在代理模型下，EI停止在低成本时平均而言是过早的，而在高成本时损失很小。在三个超参数优化基准上，一项预先注册的测试发现，在大多数高成本设置中，EI停止不劣于修正方法，而修正方法在……
tldr: 该论文为冻结-解冻贝叶斯优化提出了一种成本感知的EI停止规则，证明其期望效用不低于立即停止，并构建两步前瞻价值下界证书来识别过早停止；实验表明在高成本场景下单步前瞻通常已足够，而低成本场景下修正方法更有价值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cost-aware EI stopping rule for freeze-thaw Bayesian optimization, proves it never underperforms immediate stopping in expected utility, and introduces a two-step lookahead certificate to detect premature stops, showing that one-step lookahead typically suffices in high-cost settings while the correction matters at low costs.
